istem: A static shot of a dark brutalist chapel still life on a long concrete table: concrete gothic arch objects, a small lantern, a dark steel bowl, tall black candlesticks with burning white candles, a vase with dry branches, a large cross relief on the wall behind. The candle flames flicker gently and their warm light trembles softly on the wall; a beam of light falls diagonally from the upper left with slowly floating dust particles; a thin wisp of smoke rises from a candle. The camera does not move. Sepia toned black and white film, cinematic, shallow depth of field, film grain.

istem: A static shot of a dark brutalist chapel still life on a long concrete table with burning white candles in tall black candlesticks, concrete gothic objects, a steel bowl, a vase with dry branches and a large cross relief on the wall.
